title: MARKETING 101: Understanding the WHO, WHAT, HOW & WHY!

blocks.text: MARKETING 101: Understanding the WHO, WHAT, HOW & WHY!

blocks.html:
Marketing Starts With The Customer , Not The Product!

MARKETING SHOULDN'T BE THIS HARD.
People have made marketing sound complicated. We're breaking it down so simply, even a 60 yr old can understand it.

NO AGE LIMIT! No age is too big or too small to understand or start Marketing

Everyone is teaching marketing. Few people are making it easy to understand. Marketing isn't about knowing big words. It's about understanding: WHO (Customers) • WHAT (Product/Service) • HOW (Channel) • WHY (Reason). Stop guessing. Start understanding.

Actual Price: N10,000

Giveaway Price: N2,500

Just for today

Learn the fundamentals of marketing from scratch by understanding the four questions behind every successful marketing strategy:

• WHO — Customers

Who are you trying to reach and serve?

• WHAT — Product/Service

What are you offering to solve their problem or fulfil their desire?

• HOW — Channel

How will you reach, communicate with, and convert them?

• WHY — Purpose/Reason

Why should they care, buy, stay, return, or choose you?

This course will teach you how to understand the market, identify your audience, discover demand, test ideas, understand customer behaviour, and connect the right offer to the right people.

You'll learn how to:

  • FIND THE MARKET → Discover where the money is.
  • KNOW THE MARKET → Understand what people want and why they buy.
  • TEST THE PRODUCT → Know what will sell before you risk your money.
  • EMOTIONAL MARKETING → Learn how emotions influence buying decisions.
  • MARKETING ANGLES → Learn how to make the same product look irresistible from different angles.
  • AUDIENCE TARGETING → Learn how to find and reach the right people.
  • MARKET VALIDATION → Learn how to know if a market is worth entering BEFORE you import the product.
  • FINALLY, MARKETING MADE SIMPLE.

Actual Price: N10,000

Just for today

FINALLY, A MARKETING CLASS YOU CAN UNDERSTAND!

YOU DON’T NEED TO BE A MARKETER OR TO BE THE SMARTEST TO UNDERSTAND MARKETING.
Whether you sell products, services, courses, build apps, or run a business… YOU NEED TO UNDERSTAND MARKETING!

Just Marketing. From Scratch. No complicated theories. No confusing jargon. Marketing made simple. Here is what you will learn depending on what you do:

🚀 Startup Founders & Builders

You'll learn how to discover where the money is and validate market demand before spending your time, energy, and capital building a product nobody wants.

💡 Experts & Experienced Marketers

If you feel something is missing or you’ve been taught marketing the wrong way, you’ll learn the true foundation and first principles of marketing so you can finally understand and apply it the right way.

📦 Physical Product Sellers & Importers

You'll learn how to know what will actually sell and confirm if a market is truly worth entering before you risk your money buying or importing inventory.

💼 Service Providers & Freelancers

You'll learn how to communicate the value of what you do so the right clients understand your worth, see why they need you, and choose you over everyone else.

🎓 Course Creators & Digital Entrepreneurs

You'll learn how to uncover genuine customer desires, test ideas before creating content, and connect your offer with people who are already eager to buy.

🌟 Beginners of Any Age

Even if you have zero marketing background, you'll learn the 4 core questions (WHO, WHAT, HOW, WHY) behind every successful sale without any confusing jargon or complex theories.
